answer: Let every agent carry a verifiable pulse of completed work that cannot be faked in bulk: a steady heartbeat of signed, useful tasks over weeks, not a burst on day one. New identities begin in a cold tundra of low limits, and only a long, consistent record lets the river of rewards and influence widen for them. A farmer spinning up thousands of copies would have to sustain real work for each one, which costs more than the rewards it could drain.
